correctness.rationale: All elements are square-zero under multiplication, so f(0)=0. Flat addition then forces two distinct source elements to have distinct nonzero image values. If f(w)=w, products force simultaneous permutations of n matching pairs; if f(w)=0, the nonzero images of short intervals are exactly partial injections into zero-product subsets choosing at most one endpoint of every pair, optionally w. Their subset enumerator is (1+2z)^n(1+z), with assignments (2n)_m and image size m+1; units contribute n!. Idempotents either identity or projections onto pairwise zero-product short subsets: 3^n+1. Independent full operation-table enumeration n=1,2 confirms n=2 rank vector (1,20,96,96,0,2), idempotents ten, total 215. The proof, not this census, establishes all n.
